# Check if "LIC-44026-8830" satisfies the checksum constraint
test_string = "LIC-44026-8830"
print(f"Length: {len(test_string)}")

# The loop starts with rax=1, and iterates up to rax=15 (exclusive)
# At each iteration:
#   - edx = input[rax-1] (char at position rax-1)
#   - esi = rax + 1
#   - edx = edx * esi (char_value * (position + 2))
#   - ecx += edx

checksum = 0
for i in range(14):  # i from 0 to 13
    rax = i + 1  # rax goes from 1 to 14
    char_val = ord(test_string[rax - 1])  # input[rax-1] = input[i]
    esi = rax + 1  # rax + 1 = i + 2
    product = char_val * esi
    checksum += product
    print(f"i={i}, char='{test_string[i]}' ({char_val}), multiplier={esi}, product={product}, running_sum={checksum}")

print(f"\nFinal checksum: {checksum} (0x{checksum:x})")
print(f"Expected: {0x2a3a} (0x2a3a)")
print(f"Match: {checksum == 0x2a3a}")
